committee_objections.objection: in_zone:ma_20 buys the pullback itself, which C5 forbids, while D dist_to_20bar_high_pct 0.35 sits at the high. On the floor three of four objectors (me, seow, oneil) name the bar_high level; the resting ma_20 buy waits for a reaction, not a confirmation.
committee_objections.would_clear: Replace the trigger with h1_close_above:bar_high (a completed 1-hour close above yesterday's high).

committee_objections.objection: Trigger in_zone:ma_20 waits for a reaction while HUM sits at the high (D dist_to_20bar_high_pct 0.35, D close_vs_swing_high_pct 6.25): my method buys the breakout (C5), and the break printed on day_vol 0.83, no volume confirmation (C6). My round-1 AGREE was too loose.
committee_objections.would_clear: Trigger h1_close_above:bar_high on a buy day of day_vol 1.40 or better (C5, C6).

committee_objections.objection: in_zone:ma_20 carries no volume term; the break printed on day_vol 0.83, under 1.40, a breakout nobody bought (C16, R4). The floor confirmed no seat's trigger answers it; minervini and elder-lens would accept the volume term.
committee_objections.would_clear: A daily close above bar_high on a day printing day_vol 1.40 or better, market gate stated as a live condition (C1).

committee_objections.objection: in_zone:ma_20 on D is a resting buy in the zone. My read is a Holy Grail first pullback after fresh highs (C7; D close_vs_swing_high_pct 6.25, dist_to_20bar_high_pct 0.35), bought only on a turn back up from the 20-day, never resting in it. ADX NOT_SERVED.
committee_objections.would_clear: Trigger reclaim:ma_20 on H1 (an hourly close back above the 20-day after the pullback), wrong if close_below:ma_20-0.5atr or BEARISH_CHOCH.

committee_objections.objection: Slate trigger is still in_zone:ma_20, a swing-system dip entry needing all five set-up conditions (C3, R1); cci_20 / ma_40 are not served. HUM is a position-system break (D close_vs_swing_high_pct 6.25, dist_to_20bar_high_pct 0.35); entry is over yesterday's high (C26, C27).
committee_objections.would_clear: Trigger moved to the bar_high level: trade_above:bar_high on D, or h1_close_above:bar_high, wrong-if a close below max(fib_swing_low, base_low_20d) (C14, C29).

committee_objections.objection: in_zone:ma_20 is a resting entry with no follow-through required (C12), and ma_20 is not a value level my method tests; D close_vs_swing_high_pct 6.25 is away from value, so I join on the test of value (C3, C7).
committee_objections.would_clear: Trigger reclaim:vwap_14d on H1 with vol_x_ge:1.2: buy the first hourly close back above the 14-day VWAP on a sign-of-strength bar (C7, C12, R6).
